news.title: AVI Polymers Limited Announces Resignation of Manish Rakesh as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective November 22, 2025
news.body: AVI Polymers Limited announced that Mr. Manish Rakesh (Membership Number: A29424), who was appointed as the Company  Secretary & Compliance Officer of AVI POLYMERS  LIMITED, has submitted his/her resignation and has expressed inability to join the Company  due  to unavoidable/personal reasons. Accordingly, his/her resignation has been accepted with effect from November 22, 2025, and he/she will not be taking charge of the position.
